build_v2s_trainer: build a v2s_trainer instance with opts to initialize the BANMo training pipeline for video-to-3d reconstruction
run_train_loop: run the train method on a v2s_trainer to execute the full multi-epoch training loop with warmup and evaluation
extract_mesh_from_nerf: extract a 3D mesh from the trained NeRF model using marching cubes on the canonical or dynamic shape
save_and_load_network: save the model state dict and variables or load a pretrained network checkpoint for evaluation or fine-tuning
render_video_frames: render video frames from the trained model by calling render_vid with a batch of camera poses and embeddings
